name: Love is a secret key
description:
The Hoshin Festival is about to be held, and preparations are in full swing. However, Shinomiya suspects that the Student Council President Shirogane is secretly planning something behind her back.

One day, Shinomiya spots Shirogane smirking at his computer screen, and he immediately closes the computer when she comes near. After investigation, she finds out that Shirogane was ordering something on the academy's merchandise store website.

Shinomiya wants to know what Kaicho has ordered and turns to you for help. What exactly has Kaicho purchased, and why is he hiding it from Shinomiya? The answer lies in your hands to be discovered.
